user.title: Texecom Alerts
user.description: Point this at the texecom2mqtt bridge. The host fields are optional but strongly recommended: without them there is no way to tell a dead site apart from a dead panel.

areas.title: Areas
areas.description: These were discovered from retained MQTT messages. Choose the ones to monitor.

notify.title: Notifications
notify.description: Push is required. SMS and voice are optional but are what actually wake somebody at three in the morning. Recipients apply to SMS and voice only.

error.no_areas: No areas seen on that prefix. Check the bridge is running and the prefix matches its configuration.

init.title: Texecom Alerts options
init.description: Changes take effect immediately. No restart needed.

test_alerts.name: Test alerts
test_alerts.description: Run the full escalation ladder with a clearly marked test alert.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Limit to one site. Omit to test every configured site.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Limit to one site. Omit to acknowledge every site.

reset.name: Reset
reset.description: Return the escalation engine to idle without notifying anyone.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Limit to one site. Omit to reset every site.
